apps.name: Draw it+ (Apple Arcade)
apps.localizedDescription:
Put your creative flair to the ultimate test.

Get ready for a quick-thinking drawing challenge where your skills are tested against the clock!

In Draw It, every second counts. Sketch each word before your time runs out and see how many points you can score. 

With simple controls and a wide variety of words to draw, this super exciting fast paced game is the perfect answer for fans of art, doodle and quick play.

Whether you're jumping in for fun or aiming for a high score, there's always something new to take on. 

Race the clock in dynamic rounds, or just enjoy quick sketching and doodling as a creative break. 

It’s the perfect way to bring your ideas to life, stay quick and keep your reflexes sharp. 

Be bold, be quick - do
